_doc: HAND-AUTHORED. The reading of the Advertising Directory of Norris's General Directory of Chicago for 1844 (T-0568): where each advertising card begins and ends in the committed page text, and what it says. tools/read_norris_1844_advertiser.py turns it into claims, slicing every quote out of the text so a quote can never drift from the page.
what: The Advertising Directory, printed pages 79-116 (scan leaves 89-126), plus J. W. Norris's own General Intelligence Agency card set at the foot of printed page 65 (leaf 75), which T-0566 declared belonged to this reading.
